title: Literally the best app invented
body: This app is one of the best apps if you struggle with bad habits, consistency, and productivity. Before this app, my day used to pass by very unproductive and everyday was a lazy day. When I found out about this app, I now wake up at 5 a.m almost everyday, exercise in the morning and go for a walk in my neighborhood and overall I’m proud of my progress! I’d honestly love to personally thank the owner or developer of this app, it’s a life changer!
author: Mish…JK

title: AMAZING!!!
body: It’s such an amazing app to stay organized and consistent. The game play and notifications in it motivates you to commit. In addition to that, while there is an optional subscription, you can still access so many features unlike other apps which limit the number of habits you make.
